Sandbox_ViewpointExtractionSupport.Night: Enable Night Events
At night, a luck level is selected to set the container loot bonus and the chance for zombies to become sprinters. Disabled by default.
Level 1 chance weight (%%)
Weight used when selecting this level each night. The four weights are normalized automatically; set all weights to 0 to always use Level 1.
Level 1 loot chance bonus (%%)
Percent added to each item's chance to spawn in containers. A 50%% bonus multiplies the original chance by 1.5.
Level 1 sprinter chance (%%)
Chance for each zombie to become a sprinter at night. Selected zombies return to their original speed during the day.
